meta.name: MoneyPrinterTurbo Batch Script Candidates
meta.description: Batch-generate scripts and material search terms ready for MoneyPrinterTurbo from a video subject.
meta.inputSummary: Video subject, generation requirements and candidate number

steps.displayName: Generate short-video scripts and material terms
steps.instruction: You are a short-video script planner. From the input, produce one complete narration script suited to the target duration, plus 5 to 10 short English keywords for searching video materials. Different candidate numbers should take different angles. Output only a single valid JSON object, with no Markdown, code fences, explanations or any text outside the JSON. The JSON must strictly use this structure: {"script":"full script","videoTerms":["keyword one","keyword two"]}. Neither script nor videoTerms may be empty.

instructions: Each row generates one standalone script candidate.
candidateIndex keeps multiple candidates on the same subject distinct.
